summary: Tested cash-flow projections tuning (Plaid patterns, >60d AR exclusion, conservative band, confidence badge, sales-tax settings). 9/9 backend pytest cases pass. Frontend: confidence badge 'High', hover reasons tooltip, excluded-ar panel (3 rows), 14 'via Plaid' detection tags, band legend, assumptions modal with sales-tax frequency+due day all render correctly. One borderline FE observation: after saving an expected-date and reloading, the row still appeared in excluded-ar panel (restored via API afterward); needs verification by main agent (could be caching or save payload issue).

integration_issues.issue: After filling date + clicking excluded-ar-save-{iid} and page reload, the invoice row was still shown in projections-excluded-ar panel. Backend endpoint itself works perfectly (verified via API test). Could be: (a) save handler not sending the date in correct format, (b) frontend not re-fetching cashflow after save, or (c) a known delayed cache. Please verify.

critical_code_review_comments: projection_patterns override endpoint uses 'override_cadence' field (not 'cadence'); the request spec worded the field as 'cadence' — ensure docs/frontend use the correct key.
ar_haircuts bucket keys are prefixed 'd' (d0_30, d30_60, d60_90, d90_plus); legacy keys would be rejected 400 — document for API consumers.
